name: Renesas RZ/G3L-EVKIT

specs.Flash: 64 GB eMMC + 16 MB QSPI + Micro SD Card

description: The RZ/G3L-EVKIT is Renesas' evaluation kit for the RZ/G3L MPU: a quad-core Cortex-A55 with a Cortex-M33 real-time core, an Arm Mali GPU and a video codec engine, built as a SMARC 2.1.1 module on the Common Carrier Board II. Runs LVGL with multi-threaded software rendering or GPU rendering through NanoVG on OpenGL ES, over Wayland or DRM.
shortDescription: Renesas RZ/G3L evaluation kit, a Cortex-A55 SMARC SoM for HMI.
getStartedInstructions:
1. Open the project folder and update the submodules: `git submodule update --init --recursive` 
2. Follow the guide in the [README](https://github.com/lvgl/lv_port_linux/tree/master/boards/renesas_rz-g3l-evkit/README.md)
